content.result: Dreadnought can address multiple registered projects in one control-plane session without switching the default project, route Grapher operations explicitly by project ID, create project-targeted Orders, and dispatch those Orders into the target project's canonical root, scratch namespace, token accounting, observer testimony, and Grapher brain.
content.interpretation: The workspace default is now only a convenience route; project identity is explicit through multi-project coordination and execution, allowing one Dreadnought process to manage several independent project brains synchronously.
